capabilities: Reformat Markdown including ordered lists and tables
Update frontmatter fields such as modified dates and IDs
Generate dates with moment.js templates and RFC4122 UUIDs
extras: No longer maintained; the author states it is focused on personal Linux use and not thoroughly tested across operating systems. Default hotkey is Ctrl+Alt+L, with a separate tag refactor hotkey Ctrl+Shift+O.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to clean up inconsistently formatted Markdown or keep frontmatter values like modified dates and IDs current.

relations.evidence: For similar functionality I recommend: obsidian-linter
Other alternatives to check out :) - obsidian-plugin-prettier

summary: Rule-based formatter that fixes ugly Markdown and updates frontmatter fields like modified dates, tags, and header templates.
